annotation.authors_or_issuer: Permanent Mission of the People's Republic of China to the UN Office at Geneva (Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Governments should build AI ethics rules, norms and accountability mechanisms, with agile, tiered and categorized risk management.
R&D entities should embed ethics throughout development and keep AI under human control.
Improve transparency, explainability and reliability; avoid data and algorithm bias.
Prohibit AI uses contrary to law and ethics; set emergency mechanisms and compensation measures.
Promote international cooperation and a widely accepted global AI governance framework respecting national differences.
named_instruments_referenced: Position Paper of China on Regulating Military Applications of AI
annotation.summary_en: China's November 2022 position paper on strengthening ethical governance of AI sets out recommendations for governments on regulation, R&D, utilization and international cooperation, stressing people-centred, 'AI for good' approaches, risk early warning, tiered management, transparency, fairness, privacy, human control and inclusive international rule-making.
